  • Field Details

    • DB_MIGRATION_LOCATION

      static final String DB_MIGRATION_LOCATION
      The location of the migration files for the DataSource.

      This is a format string that takes the type of the DataSource as an argument.

      To get the final location for the implementation, use getMigrationFilesLocation() instead.

    • configureFlyway

      default void configureFlyway(org.flywaydb.core.api.configuration.FluentConfiguration config)
      Updates the Flyway configuration with configuration specific to the DataSource.

      By default, this method sets the DataSource and the location of the migration files.

      Parameters:
      config - The Flyway configuration to update.
